## Questions for the PO

### DL-001
Header: Access
Question: Who may export orders?
1. Admins only — smallest audience; finance asks an admin
2. Admins and finance — finance self-serves; wider access
3. Everyone — simplest; exposes all orders
Recommended: 2 — finance is the stated user of the export
Combinable: no
